using namespace std;

// ---------- IntList ----------
class IntList {
public:
    int* data;
    int size;
    int capacity;

    IntList() : data(new int[4]), size(0), capacity(4) {}

    ~IntList() { delete[] data; }

    bool isEmpty() const { return size == 0; }

    int size_() const { return size; }

    int get(int index) const {
        if (index < 0 || index >= size) throw out_of_range("Index out of bounds");
        return data[index];
    }

    void clear() { size = 0; }

    void set(int index, int value) {
        if (index < 0 || index >= size) throw out_of_range("Index out of bounds");
        data[index] = value;
    }

    void expand() {
        if (size >= capacity) {
            capacity <<= 1;
            int* newData = new int[capacity];
            memcpy(newData, data, size * sizeof(int));
            delete[] data;
            data = newData;
        }
    }

    void insert(int index, int value) {
        if (index < 0 || index > size) throw out_of_range("Index out of bounds");
        expand();
        memmove(data + index + 1, data + index, (size - index) * sizeof(int));
        data[index] = value;
        size++;
    }

    int delete_(int index) {
        if (index < 0 || index >= size) throw out_of_range("Index out of bounds");
        int value = data[index];
        memmove(data + index, data + index + 1, (size - index - 1) * sizeof(int));
        size--;
        return value;
    }

    void push(int value) {
        expand();
        data[size++] = value;
    }

    int pop() {
        if (size == 0) throw runtime_error("No such element");
        return data[--size];
    }

    void unshift(int value) {
        expand();
        memmove(data + 1, data, size * sizeof(int));
        data[0] = value;
        size++;
    }

    int shift() {
        if (size == 0) throw runtime_error("No such element");
        int value = data[0];
        memmove(data, data + 1, (size - 1) * sizeof(int));
        size--;
        return value;
    }
};

// ---------- IntIntMap ----------
class IntIntMap {
public:
    static const int EMPTY = INT_MIN;
    int* keys;
    int* values;
    int capacity;
    int size_;

    IntIntMap() : keys(new int[16]), values(new int[16]), capacity(16), size_(0) {
        for (int i = 0; i < capacity; i++) keys[i] = EMPTY;
    }

    ~IntIntMap() { delete[] keys; delete[] values; }

    bool isEmpty() const { return size_ == 0; }

    int size() const { return size_; }

    void clear() {
        for (int i = 0; i < capacity; i++) keys[i] = EMPTY;
        size_ = 0;
    }

    static int hash(int key) {
        int h = key * 1000003;
        h ^= h >> 16;
        return h;
    }

    bool have(int key) {
        if (key == EMPTY) throw invalid_argument("Key is EMPTY");
        int mask = capacity - 1;
        for (int i = hash(key) & mask;; i = (i + 1) & mask) {
            if (keys[i] == key) return true;
            if (keys[i] == EMPTY) return false;
        }
    }

    int get(int key, int default_) {
        if (key == EMPTY) throw invalid_argument("Key is EMPTY");
        int mask = capacity - 1;
        for (int i = hash(key) & mask;; i = (i + 1) & mask) {
            if (keys[i] == key) return values[i];
            if (keys[i] == EMPTY) return default_;
        }
    }

    void resize(int newCapacity) {
        int* oldKeys = keys;
        int* oldValues = values;
        int oldCapacity = capacity;
        keys = new int[newCapacity];
        values = new int[newCapacity];
        for (int i = 0; i < newCapacity; i++) keys[i] = EMPTY;
        int mask = newCapacity - 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < oldCapacity; i++) {
            int k = oldKeys[i];
            if (k == EMPTY) continue;
            int v = oldValues[i];
            for (int j = hash(k) & mask;; j = (j + 1) & mask) {
                if (keys[j] == EMPTY) {
                    keys[j] = k;
                    values[j] = v;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        delete[] oldKeys;
        delete[] oldValues;
        capacity = newCapacity;
    }

    void set(int key, int value) {
        if (key == EMPTY) throw invalid_argument("Key is EMPTY");
        if (size_ >= (capacity >> 1)) resize(capacity << 1);
        int mask = capacity - 1;
        for (int i = hash(key) & mask;; i = (i + 1) & mask) {
            if (keys[i] == key) {
                values[i] = value;
                return;
            }
            if (keys[i] == EMPTY) {
                keys[i] = key;
                values[i] = value;
                size_++;
                return;
            }
        }
    }
};

// ---------- Global variables ----------
int n, m;
IntList solve(int from, int to);

// ---------- solve (recursive) ----------
IntList solve(int from, int to) {
    IntList res;
    if (from + 1 == to) {
        res.push(from);
        if (from + m > n) {
            res.push(n - from);
            res.push(from - n);
        }
        res.push(m);
        if (from > m) {
            res.push(n - from);
            res.push(from);
        }
        res.push(-from);
    } else {
        int mid = (from + to) >> 1;
        IntList a = solve(from, mid);
        IntList b = solve(mid, to);
        res = IntList();
        int aSize = a.size;
        int bSize = b.size;
        int* aData = a.data;
        int* bData = b.data;
        for (int i = 0;; i += 2) {
            int bFrom = (i == 0) ? 0 : bData[i - 1];
            int bTo = (i == bSize - 1) ? n : bData[i + 1];
            int bShift = bData[i];
            int aFrom = bFrom + bShift;
            int aTo = bTo + bShift;
            int l = 0;
            int r = aSize - 1;
            while (l < r) {
                int m = (((l + r) >> 2) << 1) + 1;
                if (aData[m] <= aFrom) {
                    l = m + 1;
                } else {
                    r = m - 1;
                }
            }
            int cur = l;
            while (true) {
                res.push(bShift + aData[cur]);
                ++cur;
                if (cur == aSize) break;
                int pos = aData[cur];
                if (pos >= aTo) break;
                res.push(pos - bShift);
                ++cur;
            }
            if (i == bSize - 1) break;
            res.push(bTo);
        }
    }
    return res;
}

// ---------- Main solve ----------
void solve() {
    cin >> n >> m;
    int s;
    long long t;
    cin >> s >> t;
    s--; // convert to 0-index
    // initial loop for remainder
    for (int ct = (int)(t % n); ct != 0; ct--) {
        if (s < m) {
            s += ct;
            if (s >= n) s -= n;
        } else {
            s -= ct;
            if (s < 0) s += n;
        }
    }
    long long cycles = t / n;
    if (cycles > 0) {
        IntList cycleSolve = solve(0, n);
        int csSize = cycleSolve.size;
        int* csData = cycleSolve.data;
        IntList cycleList;
        IntIntMap cycleMap;
        for (int it = 0;; it++) {
            if (it == cycles) break;
            int prev = cycleMap.get(s, -1);
            if (prev >= 0) {
                s = cycleList.get(prev + (int)((cycles - prev) % (it - prev)));
                break;
            }
            cycleList.push(s);
            cycleMap.set(s, it);
            int l = 0;
            int r = csSize - 1;
            while (l < r) {
                int m = (((l + r) >> 2) << 1) + 1;
                if (csData[m] <= s) {
                    l = m + 1;
                } else {
                    r = m - 1;
                }
            }
            s += csData[l];
        }
    }
    cout << (s + 1) << endl;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    solve();
    return 0;
}
